text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. A matched pair of delicate small gold-tone drop earrings, tiny oval upper fittings connected to petite oval teardrop drops with pale champagne centers; conservative interpretation of small partially obscured reference details.
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image defines CLOTHING AND ACCESSORY DESIGN ONLY. Create one photorealistic wardrobe library product image on a pure white seamless background, vertical 2:3. NO person, no face, no hair, no skin, no body parts, no visible mannequin, no hanger, no display stand, no typography or watermark. Soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric/metal textures, subtle contact shadows, full item uncropped with breathing room. Faithfully retain the reference garment design rather than redesigning it. Extract ONLY the matching pair of small delicate gold drop earrings from source, displaying TWO earrings as one product pair, aligned side by side on white at equal scale. Tiny oval gold upper fittings connect to small elongated oval/teardrop drop elements with pale champagne centers. Fine thin gold outlines, restrained everyday jewelry, approximately 2 cm total length in real life, not giant chandelier earrings. Details partly hidden by reference hair: reconstruct conservatively, no elaborate added stones or branding. Clean realistic macro product photograph. Entire pair visible, no ears, hair, head, necklace, stand or card.
reproduction_note: 依据用户提供造型图整理为纯白背景无人服装、独立配饰与完整造型。小尺寸耳饰和吊坠细节、头发遮挡部分保守补全；不作精确款号或品牌鉴定。需保持设计时结合原参考，不承诺纯文字逐像素复现。
